small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 41%: shrink BLOCK_OC to 8 or 16 and keep BLOCK_SP at 64-128, and move the IC loop to the OUTER level with weight preload per (kd,kh,kw,ic) reused across the BLOCK_SP tile. Also hoist the (id_idx, ih_idx) computation out of the kw loop and combine spatial_valid masks into a single int mask to cut predicate registers. Add configs with BLOCK_OC=8/16, BLOCK_SP=128/256, num_warps=4, num_stages=2.
large_guidance: Rewrite ConvTranspose3d as an im2col-style GEMM where each program computes a (BLOCK_M=OC tile) x (BLOCK_N=output-spatial tile) output via tl.dot over K=IC*KD*KH*KW, with the gather computing input coordinates from output coordinates (transposed-conv index math: i = (o+P-k)/S only where divisible). Use tl.dot on fp32 tiles like (32,32,16) or (64,32,16) to get tensor-core-style throughput instead of the current scalar FMA over IC. Fuse the BatchNorm affine (folded from running stats) and the spatial-mean subtraction into the epilogue: compute per-(N,OC) sum in a second pass kernel that reads conv_out once, then a fused subtract kernel — or better, accumulate the per-(N,OC) sum inside the conv epilogue using atomics into a small (N,OC) buffer, eliminating the separate cudnn BN launch and the extra read/write of the 16x32x32x64x64 tensor.
